The facts: The defendant applied for a credit card, used it, then defaulted on repayment, exceeding three months, bank reported, defendant voluntarily surrendered, and bank agreed to postpone repayment. This is similar to earlier examples: credit card fraud (信用卡诈骗). In examples, credit card fraud is used for malicious overdraft with no ability to repay, using false info? In this case, they applied for a credit card, used it, then didn't repay. Did they use false info? Not mentioned. But credit card fraud includes malicious overdraft, even if info is true? In Chinese law, credit card fraud (信用卡诈骗罪) requires using false information or other means to obtain credit card and then default. However, many cases treat malicious overdraft as credit card fraud.
